description: Source code for FakeQuantize operations in PyTorch, specifically for per-tensor affine quantization, including functions for quantization, caching, backward pass, and related dispatch definitions.

methods.name: fake_quantize_per_tensor_affine
methods.description: Performs fake quantization on input tensor with specified scale, zero_point, quant_min, and quant_max.

methods.name: fake_quantize_per_tensor_affine_cachemask
methods.description: Fake quantizes tensor and returns a mask for backward pass.

methods.name: _fake_quantize_per_tensor_affine_cachemask_tensor_qparams
methods.description: Fake quantizes tensor with tensor qparams and returns a mask.

methods.name: fake_quant_quantize_per_tensor_affine_cachemask_backward
methods.description: Backward pass for fake quantization with mask.

methods.name: _get_zero_point_from_tensor
methods.description: Extracts zero point value from tensor, considering quantization range and forward/backward mode.

methods.name: _fake_quantize_learnable_per_tensor_affine
methods.description: Fake quantizes tensor with learnable scale and zero point.

methods.name: _fake_quantize_learnable_per_tensor_affine_backward
methods.description: Computes gradients for learnable scale and zero point during backpropagation.
